title: Common definitions — Artemis Hyperion evaluation corpus
description: Shared $defs referenced by candidate-record.schema.json, attempt-log.schema.json and input-spec.schema.json. Keep all files in the same directory so the relative $ref resolves.

variant.description: Approach variant (paper §4). full-agentic = agent loop + spec-fidelity critic + verify/repair + oracle gate (Hyperion default); loop-no-critic = SpecFidelityCriticService disabled; single-pass = one pass, no verify-and-repair loop.

model.description: The generating model configuration; 'id' is the grouping key for the leaderboard.

id.description: Canonical identifier used for grouping, e.g. 'gpt-oss-120b'.

agentStatus.description: AgentLoopResult.Status: how the agent loop ended.

attemptOutcome.description: GenerationOutcome. Deployable/saved := {SUCCESS, NEEDS_REVIEW}. NOT_SAVED = mechanical checks failed or generation unverified. PARTIAL = save completion could not be proven (treat as not-deployable for yield, but flag for reconciliation).

savedOutcome.description: Outcomes for which artifacts are persisted (the exported candidate corpus).

programmingLanguage.description: Only JAVA is supported by the current Hyperion generation profile (LanguageGenerationProfile).

projectType.description: Supported Java project types; drives the build recipe.

vcsCommit.description: Git commit SHA of the artifact repository at export time.

artifactRef.description: Pointer to one exported artifact, relative to the candidate directory.

path.description: Path relative to the candidate directory; directories end with '/'.

completion_tokens.description: Output tokens; include reasoning tokens if the provider bills them (recommended).

total_tokens.description: Total tokens billed; SHOULD be >= prompt_tokens + completion_tokens.

repair_iterations.description: Verify->repair cycles. If not tracked separately, omit or set equal to turns.

duration_s.description: Wall-clock duration of the generation job, seconds.

cost_usd.description: Monetary cost if provider pricing is configured; null/omitted otherwise.

range.description: Inclusive numeric bound; specify min, max, or both.
